experiments.hypothesis: The stored fixed pair is an ordinary blake3-r1 collision, and repeated half-key sampling shows full distinctness consistent with uniform 128-bit half keys.
experiments.scope: Selected blake3-r1 target; 256 organizer trials, each drawing 512 seeded half-key samples plus replaying the stored witness pair.

experiments.hypothesis: Flipping the MSB of message word 9 yields exactly the stated 256-bit output difference with probability about one half (offline 130880/262144).
experiments.scope: Selected blake3-r1 target; 256 organizer trials of seeded base messages with the fixed word-9 MSB difference.
